name: Conversational Banking Assistant

name: Model Risk Governance Operating Model
description: Operating model for who owns model risk across the bank. Currently contested between CDO and CIO. Until resolved, model deployment cadence is blocked. Regulatory bar from SR 11-7 makes this urgent rather than optional.

aligned_rationale: Blocker for 4 other AI initiatives. SR 11-7 regulatory urgency rising. The single most-impactful unblock available — resolving this unblocks Credit Decisioning, Fraud Refresh, Advisor AI expansion, and Conversational Banking.

name: Credit Decisioning Modernization

aligned_rationale: Single largest AI investment in the portfolio. Directly tied to NIM compression mitigation. The most-cited Move candidate in Sentinel's exploration threads.
